entries.title: Show HN: I trained a 125M model to autocomplete piano on-device
entries.author: simedw
entries.current_title: Show HN: I trained a 125M model to autocomplete piano on-device
entries.excerpt: I trained a 125M-parameter transformer to autocomplete piano performances in real time (~108 notes/sec on an iPhone 15). The idea is basically GitHub Copilot or Tabnine, except instead of prompting it with code, you prompt it by playing a few notes on a MIDI piano. The model then continues what you played, entirely on-device. The app is free if anyone wants to try it. Happy to answer questions about the model, training, Core ML, or the many things that didn't work.
entries.guide_zh: 训练一亿两千五百万参数模型实时续弹钢琴，用 MIDI 音符作为音乐提示。

entries.title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
entries.author: HenryNdubuaku
entries.current_title: Show HN: Needle2: 14MB agentic LLM for phones, wearables, smart home and robots
entries.excerpt: Hey HN, Henry from Cactus here! We previously released Cactus Needle, a 14MB agentic LLM for tool call, device use, and structured extraction for phones, wearables, smart homes, small robots and microcontrollers. We got really great feedback here, and have now incorporated the suggestions to release Needle 2. The whole model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in 28MB of RAM; 45m parameters at 2bit compression. Needle hits 500 tokens/sec decode speed on a Raspber
entries.guide_zh: Needle2 将手机、穿戴设备与小型机器人的工具调用模型压缩到 14MB。

entries.title: Show HN: Woxi - Open-source Mathematica / Wolfram Language reimplementation
entries.author: adius
entries.current_title: Show HN: Woxi - Open-source Mathematica / Wolfram Language reimplementation
entries.excerpt: Woxi is an interpreter for the Wolfram Language written in Rust. It comes with Woxi Studio, a Mathematica-like GUI built with iced, but you can also use Woxi through a CLI, Jupyter kernel, Python package, npm package, or WASM module. Compared with wolframscript / Mathematica, the main differences are: - Free and open source - Very fast startup - Typically milliseconds rather than seconds for the Wolfram kernel, making Woxi practical for shell scripts, one-liners, and other sh
entries.guide_zh: Woxi 用 Rust 重新实现 Wolfram Language，并提供类 Mathematica 界面与多种入口。
